visual.general_description: Grayscale fluorescein angiogram of the retina with a yellow arrow at a bright spot.
visual.detailed_description: A circular grayscale fundus image with a black surround, in the style of a fluorescein angiogram. Bright white branching retinal vessels radiate across the field from a vessel-rich area on the left side. A small bright spot is marked by a yellow arrow pointing from the left toward it in the lower central part of the field. Around that spot the background is darker and mottled. A dark crescent-shaped band lies across the lower part of the field and a dark wedge-shaped band lies near the upper left, both with straight edges. Faint scattered smudges are visible near the right edge. Small printed text in the lower left corner of the image includes the number 200 followed by a small unit-like glyph; it is partly illegible. No panel letters, names or other identifying text are legible.

visual.general_description: Grayscale OCT cross-section with red and yellow arrows.
visual.detailed_description: A wide grayscale cross-sectional OCT scan with a black background. Layered tissue bands run across the image, forming a raised dome-shaped elevation on the left side with a granular, mid-gray interior. A red arrow in the upper left points down and to the right at the margin of this elevation. A thin bright line arches over the top of the elevation from the left and continues as a separate thin line toward the upper right, separated from the underlying layers by a dark space. A yellow arrow at the top points down toward the end of the thin line near the edge of the raised area. Below, the retinal layers appear as parallel bright and gray bands. No panel letters, scale bars or text are visible.

visual.general_description: Grayscale OCT cross-section with a dark cavity (red arrow) and a thin surface line (yellow arrow).

Parallel bright and gray retinal layers run across the image, with a dark rounded cavity with lobulated edges cutting into the layers near the center. A red arrow at the upper left points down and to the right toward the cavity. A yellow arrow above and to the right points straight down at a thin bright line running along the surface to the right of the cavity. Dark space lies above the tissue and beneath it are further bright and gray bands. No panel letters, scale bars or text are visible.
